name: steph7
caption:
PICK 7 🎮🏀 Six teams passed on Steph Curry. Minnesota passed twice.

• 2009 draft: Memphis takes Hasheem Thabeet at #2
• Minnesota takes Ricky Rubio at #5 and Jonny Flynn at #6
• His dad wanted the Knicks at #8. We take him at #7
• Since then: 4 titles, 2 MVPs
• This season: 27.8 PPG through his first 10 games

Who blew it worse: Memphis or Minnesota? 👇

facts.claim: 2009 NBA draft: Hasheem Thabeet 2nd to Memphis, Ricky Rubio 5th and Jonny Flynn 6th to Minnesota, Stephen Curry 7th to Golden State (6 teams passed on him, 0 took him before pick 7)

Curry's father Dell wanted him drafted 8th by the New York Knicks and called teams with higher picks urging them not to draft him; Minnesota took two other point guards at 5 and 6; Curry: 4× NBA champion, 2× MVP
